पृषत् n. A drop of water or any other liquid; (according to some authorities, this word can only be used in the plural in this sense).
पृषत्-अंश, -अश्व m. wind, air.
पृषत्-अंश, -अश्व m. wind, air.
पृषत्-आज्य n. ghee mixed with coagulated milk.
पृषतांपति m. wind.
पृषत्-बल n. name of the horse of wind.
पृषत m. 1. The spotted antelope; 2. a drop of water, R.iii.3., iv.27, vi.51; 3. a spot, a mark.
पृषत-अश्व m. air, wind.
पृषत्क m. An arrow, धनुर्भृतां हस्तवतां पृषत्काः R.vii.45, यदि कुसुमपृषत्कैर्देवदेवस्य जेता Vid.Bh.i.
पृषंति m. A drop of water, e.g. पयःपृषंतिभिः स्पृष्ट्वा यांति वाताः शनैः शनैः.
पृषभाषा f. The same as पूषभासा q.v.
पृषाकरा f. A small stone.
पृषातक n. Ghee mixed with coagulated milk.

पृषोदर m. Air, wind. (The word is derived by native grammarians from पृषत् and उदर, the final त् of the former being dropped in the compound. The word is taken as a type of such irregular compounds in Pun ini’s grammar.)
पृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Asked, inquired, interrogated, e.g. नापुष्टः कस्यचिद्ब्रूयात्; 2. Sprinkled.
पृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Asked, inquired, interrogated, e.g. नापुष्टः कस्यचिद्ब्रूयात्; 2. Sprinkled.
पृष्टहायन m. 1. A species of grain; 2. an elephant.
पृष्टि f. Inquiry, interrogation.
पृष्ठ n. 1. The back, the hinder part, the rear; 2. the back of an animal, M.iv.72; 3. the surface, the upper side, R.xii.67, iv.31, Am.
; 4. the back, the other side (as of a document), Yaj.ii.93; 5. the flat roof of a house.
पृष्ठ-अस्थि n. the back-bone.
पृष्ठ-गोप, -रक्ष m. a soldier who protects the rear of a warrior while he is fighting.
पृष्ठ-गोप, -रक्ष m. a soldier who protects the rear of a warrior while he is fighting.
पृष्ठ-ग्रंथि a. hump-backed.
पृष्ठ-चक्षुस्, -दृष्टि a. a bear.
पृष्ठ-चक्षुस्, -दृष्टि a. a bear.
पृष्ठ-तल्पन n. the exterior muscles on the back of an elephant.
पृष्ठ-तस् ind. 1. behind the back, behind, Bg.xi.40, M.iv.154; 2. backwards; 3. secretly, covertly.(पृष्ठतः कृ 1. to neglect, to forsake; 2. to renounce, to desist from; 3. to take on the back.)
पृष्ठ-फल n. the superficial contents of a figure.
पृष्ठ-भाग m. the back.
पृष्ठ-मांस n. a fleshy protuberance on the back.
पृष्ठ-मांस˚अद, ˚अदन (I) a. backbiter, slanderer.
पृष्ठ-मांस˚अद, ˚अदन (I) a. backbiter, slanderer.
पृष्ठ-मांस˚अदन (II) n. backbiting, (पृष्ठमांसादनं तद्यत् परोक्षे दोषकीर्तनम् Hemacandra).
पृष्ठ-यान n. riding.
पृष्ठ-वंश m. the back-bone.
पृष्ठ-वास्तु n. the upper story of a house.
पृष्ठ-वाह्, -वाह्य m. a draught-ox.
पृष्ठ-वाह्, -वाह्य m. a draught-ox.
पृष्ठ-शय a. sleeping on the back.
पृष्ठ-शृंग m. a wild goat.
पृष्ठ-शृंगिन् m. 1. a buffalo; 2. a ram; 3. a eunuch; 4. an epithet of Bhīma.
पृष्ठक n. The back.
पृष्ठ्य (I) a. (f. ष्ठ्या) Relating to the back.
पृष्ठ्य (II) m. A pack-horse.
